description: Render RegA GO decision table as figure artifact (cGMP-PDE IBA-only highlighted)
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
dec = pd.DataFrame([
 ["GO:0004115","3',5'-cyclic-AMP PDE","IDA(9435289)+IMP(15752425)","RETAIN (core MF)"],
 ["GO:0004114","3',5'-cyclic-nucleotide PDE","IDA(9582277)","RETAIN (parent)"],
 ["GO:0047555","3',5'-cyclic-GMP PDE","IBA only","REMOVE / non-core (LEAD)"],
 ["GO:0000156","phosphorelay response reg.","IMP(10488068)","RETAIN"],
],columns=["GO_ID","Term","Evidence(QuickGO)","Curation lead"])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,2.2)); ax.axis('off')
colors=[['w']*4 if r!=2 else ['#ffd9d9']*4 for r in range(len(dec))]
t=ax.table(cellText=dec.values,colLabels=dec.columns,loc='center',cellLoc='left',cellColours=colors)
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(9); t.scale(1,1.5)
ax.set_title("RegA (Q23917) GO decision table — cGMP-PDE (GO:0047555) is IBA-only (lead: remove/non-core)",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("rega_go_decision_table.png",dpi=140,bbox_inches='tight')
print("saved figure"); print(dec.to_string(index=False))
